WARP H2 plain CONNECT headers, bare IP capsules, and absent ALPN compatibility
H3 datagrams, route advertisement, framing and numeric varint decoding
bounded capsule parsing and H2 flow control below capsule size
terminal wakeups for SYN, established TCP reads and blocked writes, UDP reads and full sends
input and output packet channel closure, first failure preservation and stale abort handles
UDP selected-peer filtering, empty datagrams, payload ceilings and IPv6 MTU capability loss
socket and ephemeral-port limits, cancellation and released capacity

diagnostics_follow_up.change: Status retains assigned addresses while computing live IPv6 capability from an atomic availability/address/MTU snapshot; inherited reconnect comment corrected.

limitations: No live WARP operation or secret-file discovery was performed by the core crate agent.
This evidence does not include the separately owned six ingress/egress pair integration matrix or long soak.
One fixed-mode session is implemented; applications create a fresh controller to retry after failure.
UDP fragmentation is absent; payload ceilings at MTU 1280 are 1252 for IPv4 and 1232 for IPv6.
Socket limits and buffers are conservative constants: 64 sockets and 384 KiB total TCP buffers per socket.
